## PROFILE
A student building GPU kernels, fine-tuned language models, and full-stack applications with real users. Nine Triton kernels benchmarked against PyTorch over nine consecutive weeks, each published with its numbers; a LoRA fine-tune of Qwen3-14B served behind vLLM at 2.3s against the 5.7s model it replaced; founder of Soulor, live in six languages.

## EDUCATION
Year 11, Auckland, New Zealand. Expected graduation 2028
Relevant coursework: IB Math AA HL, NCEA Level 2

## TECHNICAL SKILLS
GPU & ML: Triton, PyTorch, Python, GPU benchmarking and profiling, LoRA fine-tuning, vLLM, Modal, eval harnesses
Full-stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Next.js, React, Supabase/Postgres, Web Audio API, Stripe
Practice: Git, GitHub Actions, Playwright end-to-end testing, web security hardening (CSP, XSS)

## GPU SYSTEMS & OPTIMIZATION
One Triton kernel per week, benchmarked against PyTorch.
- Cut fused cross-entropy to 15.90 ms against PyTorch's 24.03 ms at vocab 131,072 (1.51x), at 1.67x less peak memory, by collapsing five live copies of the logits tensor to three.
- Raised fused softmax from ~55 GB/s to ~230 GB/s, and established T4's ~240 GB/s practical ceiling by measurement.

## DISTRIBUTED AI INFRASTRUCTURE & DISPATCH
- Fine-tuned Qwen3-14B with LoRA on a 1,526-row corpus spanning five generation paths in six languages, for $1.30 of compute.
- Deployed an optimized cold-start vLLM architecture that led the production chain at 2.3–4.1s against the original 5.7s model.
- Built warm-gate routing: the gateway probes for a warm container and the probe doubles as the warm-up, so a 108 s cold start never reaches a user.
- Fine-tuned MusicGen-small for bar-locked stems, built the eval harness scoring clips as production.

## PROJECTS
### Soulor — [soulor.app](https://soulor.app/)
Founder, May 2026 – present
- Built and shipped an AI app that reads a difficult situation through seven analyst perspectives ranked by evidence, then lets the user rehearse the conversation against a simulated version of the other person, scored on empathy, clarity and confidence.
- Live in six languages with chat encrypted at rest. Cut reply latency from 7.9s to 2.0s through model and infrastructure changes, and serve the simulation through a single model provider whose terms forbid training on user data.
- Added a Work mode for managers and a cohort report for whoever pays, aimed at a two-week paid pilot in contact centres.
### VNportal — [vnportal.vercel.app](https://vnportal.vercel.app/)
May 2026 – present
- A vinyl and music community platform for creation, recreation, and discussion, promoting innovative music creation with AI-assistance.
- Controllable Audio Synthesis | Onset Charting | Source Cascade | Stem Synthesis
